description_target.target_text: Draw beams below shape for columns with scattered dots below

racket_target.raw_code:
;; Largest component is the central shape
;; Scattered color: the OTHER non-zero color
;; For each col in shape span, find bottommost shape cell
(rule! (lambda (g) (let* ((h (rows g)) (w (cols g))) (let* ((objs (objects g 0)) (sorted-objs (sort objs (lambda (a b) (> (obj-size a) (obj-size b))))) (shape-obj (first sorted-objs)) (shape-color (obj-color shape-obj)) (shape-cells (obj-cells shape-obj)) (bbox (obj-bbox shape-obj)) (c1 (second bbox)) (c2 (fourth bbox)) (scattered-color (let loop ((r 0) (c 0)) (cond ((>= r h) 0) ((>= c w) (loop (+ r 1) 0)) (else (let ((v (at g r c))) (cond ((and (!= v 0) (!= v shape-color)) v) (else (loop r (+ c 1))))))))) (in-shape? (lambda (r c) (let loop ((cs shape-cells)) (cond ((null? cs) #f) ((and (= (first (car cs)) r) (= (second (car cs)) c)) #t) (else (loop (cdr cs))))))) (bottom-in-col (lambda (col) (let loop ((cs shape-cells) (best -1)) (cond ((null? cs) best) ((and (= (second (car cs)) col) (> (first (car cs)) best)) (loop (cdr cs) (first (car cs)))) (else (loop (cdr cs) best)))))) (has-scatter-below (lambda (col start) (let loop ((r start)) (cond ((>= r h) #f) ((= (at g r col) scattered-color) #t) (else (loop (+ r 1)))))))) (for/fold ((out g)) ((col (range c1 (+ c2 1)))) (let ((bottom (bottom-in-col col))) (cond ((= bottom -1) out) ((has-scatter-below col (+ bottom 1)) (let fill ((r (+ bottom 1)) (gg out)) (cond ((>= r h) gg) (else (fill (+ r 1) (set-cell gg r col scattered-color)))))) (else out))))))))
